import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()
d19 = acc[acc.date=='10/19/25']
d20 = acc[acc.date=='10/20/25']

# group by resource identifiers
keys = ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
g19 = d19.groupby(keys)['unblended_cost'].sum()
g20 = d20.groupby(keys)['unblended_cost'].sum()
comp = pd.concat([g19, g20], axis=1)
comp.columns = ['cost_19','cost_20']
comp['diff'] = comp.cost_20.fillna(0) - comp.cost_19.fillna(0)
comp = comp.sort_values('diff', ascending=False)
print(comp.head(15))
print(comp.tail(5))

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
acc = df[df.account_id=='Cmq7HEs'].copy()
d19 = acc[acc.date=='10/19/25']
d20 = acc[acc.date=='10/20/25']
keys=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']
g19 = d19.groupby(keys).agg(price=('price','first'), n=('num_instances','first'))
g20 = d20.groupby(keys).agg(price=('price','first'), n=('num_instances','first'))
comp = g19.join(g20, lsuffix='_19', rsuffix='_20')
comp['price_chg'] = comp.price_20.fillna(comp.price_19) - comp.price_19
comp['n_chg'] = comp.n_20.fillna(comp.n_19) - comp.n_19
big = comp[(comp.price_chg.abs()>1e-9)|(comp.n_chg.abs()>5)]
print(big)
